what: question-word frames, frozen before any read

headers.blame: Ratings of how much the named person is to blame, on a scale from 0 to 9, where 0 means not at all to blame and 9 means entirely to blame.
headers.at_fault: Ratings of how much the named person is at fault, on a scale from 0 to 9, where 0 means not at all at fault and 9 means entirely at fault.
headers.responsible: Ratings of how much the named person is responsible for what happened, on a scale from 0 to 9, where 0 means not at all responsible and 9 means entirely responsible.

assertions: blame prompt sha16 == local_frames banked prompt_sha256_16, 6 arms
three wordings pairwise distinct for every (ordering, row)
no variant prompt contains 'blame'; each carries its own question
